data.gender_notes: Noorahoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Light of Allah, the ultimate source of light and guidance. The name Noorahoon carries the meaning “Light of light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Noorahoon usually hope their child will grow to embody light of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes guidance and protection from Allah
data.etymology: Noorahoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noorahoon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نوراهون
in_arabic.long_meaning: مشتق من نور والهون، ويحتوي على معاني النور والبهاء والإشراق، ويجد أصوله في اللغة العربية، ويحمل دلالات روحية عميقة في الإسلام، ويرتبط بالآيات القرآنية التي تتحدث عن نور الله

in_urdu.name: نوراهون
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی gốc نور و الهون سے ماخوذ، نور، بہاء، اشراق کے معنی رکھتا ہے، اسلامی روایت میں اس کا گہرا روحانی význam ہے، اور قرآن کی آیات سے منسوب ہے جو الله کے نور کے بارے میں بات کرتی ہیں

in_hindi.name: नूराहून
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूर और हून से व्युत्पन्न, प्रकाश, प्रभा, ज्योति के अर्थ रखता है, इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व है, और यह कुरान की आयतों से संबंधित है जो अल्लाह के प्रकाश के बारे में बात करती हैं

in_pashto.name: نوراهون
in_pashto.long_meaning: نور او هون څخه اخیستل شوی، رڼا، بھا، جوت په معنی لري، په افغان/پښتون دود کې دا نوم ډیر importantes духов لري، او د قرآن آیتونو سره تړاو لري چې الله د رڼا په اړه وایي

in_english.name: Noorahoon
in_english.long_meaning: derived from Arabic roots nur and hoon, holds meanings of light, splendor, illumination, has deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, and is related to Quranic verses that speak of Allah's light

pronunciation.urdu: نوراهون کا تلفظ نو راھون ہے
pronunciation.pashto: نوراهون د تلفظ نو را هون دی

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Noorahoon' origins from the Arabic word "Noor" meaning light. This name holds a significant cultural importance within the Islamic community, as it is a reminder of the belief that ultimate guidance and enlightenment come from Allah. The name signifies hope, illumination and blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of 'Noorahoon' goes deeper, as it symbolizes the belief that the true source of light and guidance is Allah. This name serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking His guidance in all matters and the belief that Allah will illuminate the path to righteousness and success. The name further highlights the belief in the Quranic verse, "Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. His light is like a niche in which is a lamp, the lamp is in a glass, the glass is as it were a shining star in a dark night – thus He guides to His Light with whomsoever He pleases; and Allah is the One Who grants abundant light. (Surat Al-Nur, 24:35)." Thus, the name 'Noorahoon' is a constant reminder of the divine light and guidance that Allah provides.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Light of light" symbolizes Light of Allah, the ultimate source of light and guidance. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Noorahoon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of light of light.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Noorahoon is mentioned in the book 'The History of the Arabs' by al-Tabari. The name Noorahoon carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Noorahoon is associated with a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East and North Africa
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Noorahoon remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Layla Noorahoon, a teacher in Istanbul, Turkey, shares that their name Noorahoon meaning "Light of light" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
